title.description: Headline shown when the operation succeeds.

story.description: Opening text on the title screen.

region.description: Where this operation sits on the world map used to choose it: a place name and a real-world longitude and latitude.

population.description: People living here; the base for tax income.

lat.description: The atlas shows 84 degrees north to 58 degrees south.

intel.description: Extra briefing lines that each survey level adds, in order.

unlocks.description: Operations (by id) that open when this one is won. If no operation in a pack lists any, they open as a chain.

sequence.description: When true the required objectives must be done in the order listed; the briefing points at the one to do now.

vehicles.description: Cars and vans on the roads. Each may have a driver who drives it along its route.

bystanders.description: Civilians and police who share the streets. They are neutral until an operator gives police a reason to act.

patrol.description: Waypoints an opposition unit walks after its start, returning to the start and repeating.

script.description: Steps this person follows instead of a patrol: walk, wait, trigger (wait for an operator to come near), say (speak a line), escape (walk off the map), enter (walk to a vehicle and get in as its driver), drive (take it to a point on the roads) and leave (get out).

scriptLoop.description: Start the script again when it ends.

vehicle.description: For enter: the id of the vehicle to get into.

driver.description: The unit definition of the person at the wheel, if any.

patrol.description: Waypoints along the roads the driver follows, returning to the start and repeating.

type.description: protect: named people stand in the zone alive (an escort; losing one fails the operation). persuade: named people follow the squad. eliminate: everyone in a group is down or won over. destroy-vehicle / use-vehicle: named vehicles. take-item: an operator carries `item`. evacuate: persuaded followers stand in the zone.

group.description: eliminate: a side or unit role such as opposition, guard or enemy-agent.

count.description: persuade, evacuate: how many are enough.

item.description: take-item: the equipment id to carry.

targetZone.description: The zone to reach, use, hold or extract through. Not used by disable.

targets.description: The placements (or vehicles) the objective is about; disable needs opposition placements, all of which must be disabled and not got away.

holdSeconds.description: hold: seconds an operator must stay in the zone.
